references.text: God's first call to Abraham with the words 'go for yourself' (lekh lekha), which is repeated in 22:2 when he is asked to offer his son.
God stops Abraham from offering Isaac and confirms that he fears God since he did not refuse to give his only son.
Solomon builds the temple on Mount Moriah, the place where God told Abraham to offer Isaac.
The Lord tests the righteous – just as He tested Abraham by asking him to offer Isaac.
God gave His only Son – a typological parallel to Abraham who was asked to offer his only son whom he loved.
God did not spare His own Son – language that reflects Abraham's willingness not to spare his only son.
Abraham's faith when he was tested and offered Isaac, his only son, is used as the prime example of faith.
Abraham was justified by works when he offered his son Isaac on the altar.
